onboarding.restartHint: Restart it any time from Settings ({pause}).
onboarding.skipped.title: Tour skipped
onboarding.skipped.body: The sky is yours. Restart the tour any time from Settings ({pause}).
onboarding.announce.skipped: Guided tour ended. Restart it any time from Settings.
onboarding.step.look.hint: Hold {headLook} and move the mouse to turn your head, or steer the ship with {pitch} and {yaw}.
onboarding.step.look.hint.pad: Steer the ship with {pitch} and {yaw} to look around.
onboarding.step.look.science: You are {altKm} km above Earth, near the height of the International Space Station. An orbit here takes about {orbitMin} minutes at {orbitKmS} km/s.
onboarding.step.throttle.hint: Raise the throttle with {throttleUp} or hold {thrust}. Slide sideways with {strafeX}, up and down with {strafeY}.
onboarding.step.throttle.hint.pad: Hold {thrust} to raise the throttle. Slide sideways with {strafeX}, up and down with {strafeY}.
onboarding.step.throttle.science: Thrusters need no air to push against: throwing mass backwards pushes the ship forwards (Newton's third law).
onboarding.step.target.hint: {targetNext} cycles targets and {targetReticle} picks the one under the reticle. A bracket marks your target.
onboarding.step.target.science: Moonlight reaching you now left the Moon about {moonLightS} seconds ago.
onboarding.step.align.goal: Point the nose at the Moon
onboarding.step.align.hint: Steer onto the bracket with {pitch} and {yaw}, or press {autoAlign} to align automatically.
onboarding.step.align.hint.pad: Steer onto the bracket with {pitch} and {yaw}.
onboarding.step.align.science: The Moon is {moonDiameterKm} km across, yet it covers only about half a degree of your sky.
onboarding.step.cruise.hint: Press {modeNext} to step up through the drives: {thrusters}, {impulse}, {cruise}.
onboarding.step.cruise.science: Apollo 11 took about {apolloDays} days to reach the Moon. The cruise drive is game fiction.
onboarding.step.approach.hint: Raise the throttle with {throttleUp} and keep the bracket ahead. The drive slows down by itself as you arrive.
onboarding.step.approach.hint.pad: Hold {thrust} to raise the throttle and keep the bracket ahead. The drive slows down by itself as you arrive.
onboarding.step.approach.science: The Moon is {moonDistanceKm} km from Earth on average, about {moonEarths} Earths side by side.
onboarding.step.land.hint: Near the surface the ship drops to thrusters. Descend with {strafeY} and touch down slowly.
onboarding.step.land.science: Lunar gravity is {moonGravity} m/s², about 1/{moonGravityOneIn} of Earth's.
onboarding.step.map.hint: Press {toggleMap} to see the whole Solar System.
onboarding.step.map.science: Planet positions are computed for the current date from JPL ephemerides; map distances are compressed to fit.
onboarding.step.hyperspeed.goal: Choose a star and engage hyperspeed
onboarding.step.hyperspeed.hint: Pick a star on the star map, or cycle targets with {targetNext}, then press {hyperspeed}.
onboarding.step.hyperspeed.science: Proxima Centauri, the nearest star after the Sun, is {proximaLy} light-years away. Faster-than-light travel is game fiction.
onboarding.step.done.hint: Every star you can target is a real, catalogued star. Go and see them.
onboarding.step.done.science: Distances and light-travel times on the HUD are real. Only the drive is fiction.
onboarding.nudge.moonTarget: Your target is not the Moon: press {targetNext} until it is.
onboarding.nudge.useCruise: Thrusters would take more than a day: switch to cruise with {modeNext}.
onboarding.nudge.realign: Turn back toward the bracket, or press {autoAlign}.
onboarding.nudge.realign.pad: Turn back toward the bracket with {pitch} and {yaw}.
onboarding.nudge.pickStar: Target a star first: open the map with {toggleMap} and choose one.
onboarding.nudge.pickStarOnMap: Choose a star: “{button}” lists the named stars nearby.
onboarding.nudge.closeMap: Close the map with {toggleMap}, then press {hyperspeed}.
onboarding.nudge.gravityWell: Hyperspeed will not engage this close to {body}: fly farther out first.
onboarding.settings.restart.hint: Replays the opening. Your ship returns to low Earth orbit.
onboarding.demo.title: Guided opening lab
onboarding.demo.lede: The tour card over a simulated ship. Fly with your own bindings, or fake each condition below.
